content.overview: An issue is a material proposition of fact or law that one side affirms and the other denies.
content.study: Bad issues produce a bad trial. Strike issues that are not material. A preliminary issue of jurisdiction or bar can be tried first under Rule 2.

distinctions.title: Scope of o14-r-1
